audit.why: Sylas owns levels 1-5 on a 50.39% owner win rate with 1284 games; Aurelion Sol takes over from first item as stardust and Q range scale. Level chart direction matches.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 spike credited to Petricite Burst (passive).
audit.why: Sylas's level 6 spike is Hijack (R, 80/55/30s), which steals Aurelion Sol's Falling Star. Petricite Burst is only the auto-attack chain proc and attack speed. Aurelion Sol's spikes are E at 3, W at 4, R at 6, then RoA/Seraph's.
audit.corrected: Level 6 = Hijack steals Falling Star; his rank-1 R is 80s, so a spent Hijack is an 80-second window.

audit.whatIsWrong: Astral Flight terrain vs Sylas dashes and the Hijack-steals-your-R interaction were both absent.
audit.why: Astral Flight (W) creates terrain, which blocks Abscond/Abduct (E) and the Kingslayer (W) lunge. Kingslayer heals off champions, so Grievous Wounds timing decides extended trades. Hijack copies Falling Star / The Skies Descend. Breath of Light (Q) and Astral Flight are both interruptible channels — Chain Lash's slow does not cancel them, but any hard CC from a Hijacked ultimate does.
audit.corrected: Hold W for his engage as a wall, not for poke; buy anti-heal before the second item; treat a spent Hijack as your all-in window.

audit.why: Real numbers exist: Abscond 13/12/11/10/9, Kingslayer 12/10.5/9/7.5/6, Hijack 80/55/30, Astral Flight 22/20.5/19/17.5/16.
audit.corrected: Ground the field in those cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[6].side said 'Skill' while win[6] said 'Aurelion Sol'.
audit.why: The two layers render the same row and disagreed.

edits.before: Level 6: Petricite Burst gives him a free reset or a stolen ultimate, letting him force fights on his terms.
edits.after: Level 6: Hijack takes your Falling Star outright, so he holds the stun and forces the fight on his own terms.

edits.before: Petricite Burst gives him a free ultimate to reset the trade or steal one of yours off a nearby wave, snowballing the all-in even harder.
edits.after: Hijack (R) copies your Falling Star on an 80s cooldown at rank 1 — he stuns you with your own ultimate, so fight while Hijack is spent.

edits.before: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct: matchup-defining — Dash into chain-stun — punish him hard while it is down. It governs your forward steps. - W Astral Flight spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Abscond (E) is 13s at rank 1 and the recast Abduct is his only chain-stun — step up the second it is spent. - Kingslayer (W) is 12s early and heals off you; it is his sustain, not his burst. - Astral Flight is 22s at rank 1: spend it on poke and his next E kills you.

edits.before: Dash into chain-stun — punish him hard while it is down. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: Abscond into Abduct is a 13s chain-stun at rank 1. Farm from tower until you have R, then contest on his empty E.

edits.before: W-flyby: fly a lateral arc, drag Q across Sylas for two seconds of burn + stacks, and land outside his answer range — repeat forever from one item.
edits.after: Astral Flight lays terrain: drop the flight path between you and Sylas and both Abscond and the Kingslayer lunge stop dead. Keep Flash for the Hijacked ultimate.

edits.before: Your flight is your only escape — a W spent poking is a death sentence against the next gank.
edits.after: Astral Flight is your only escape and your only dash-wall; a W spent poking hands him a free Abduct.

edits.before: Level 6 is the danger point: Sylas can steal an ultimate off a nearby laner or just use Petricite Burst's free heal-reset to renew his all-in, so expect a dive attempt the moment he hits it. Keep your Q on cooldown-watch and try to land a stun before he closes the gap rather than after. Ward your flanks since he loves to roam off deep wards and duel side-lane targets with his stolen ultimate. If you can survive to your first completed item without dying twice, the lane starts turning — his damage plateaus while your star size and Q range keep scaling.
edits.after: Level 6 is the danger point: Hijack steals your Falling Star or an ultimate off a nearby laner, so expect a dive the moment he hits it — but it is 80s at rank 1, and a spent Hijack is your window. Land Falling Star before he closes rather than after, and remember Astral Flight's terrain walls off both Abscond and the Kingslayer lunge, so hold the W for his engage. Kingslayer heals him through chip, so buy Grievous Wounds early. Survive to your first completed item without dying twice and the lane turns — his damage plateaus while your stardust and Q range keep scaling.

edits.before: If Sylas takes first blood, tighten up: Abscond / Abduct is now always up in your head. A second kill means the duel is over and the game isn’t — farm with E executes and stay relevant through the stardust curve.
edits.after: If Sylas takes first blood, tighten up: a fed Kingslayer heals most of the trade back, so anti-heal moves up your build. A second kill means the duel is over and the game is not — clear with E executes and bank stardust from behind your wave.
